standard_prerequisites.name: The category of dotted arrows and its base change reduction
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used throughout the counted proof (source lines 9706-9730)
standard_prerequisites.use: Reformulates the existence hypothesis as a lifting property for dotted arrows.

standard_prerequisites.name: The valuative criterion for universally closed morphisms through the locality of universal closedness
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 9731-9755)
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces universal closedness to the valuative lifting property.

standard_prerequisites.name: The closed immersion and quasi-compactness statements used to reduce the test diagram
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 9756-9765)
standard_prerequisites.use: Allows the diagram to be replaced by one over an integral scheme.

core_obligations: Set up the valuative diagram: take a valuation ring with fraction field, a morphism from the fraction field to the source and a compatible morphism from the ring, and use the base change reduction for dotted arrows to put the diagram in a convenient form (proof lines 9705-9730)

Reduce the target: replace the spectrum of the valuation ring by an integral scheme whose generic point is the given fraction field and whose special point realizes the given ring morphism, using the quasi-compactness hypothesis (proof lines 9731-9765)

Apply existence and conclude: existence of a dotted arrow in the reduced diagram gives a lift in the original one, and the valuative criterion for universal closedness converts this into the assertion (proof lines 9766-9771)
proof_roadmap: 取赋值环 A、分式域 K 与 x: Spec(K) → X、y: Spec(A) → Y、γ。
用点箭头范畴在基变换下的不变性把图化成便于处理的形式；由准紧性把目标换成以 K 为泛点的整概型。
存在性假设给出点箭头 ⇒ 原图也有点箭头；由一致闭的赋值判据得 f 一致闭。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a quasi-compact morphism of algebraic stacks satisfying the existence clause of the valuative criterion is universally closed (author lemma at source lines 9694-9703, label lemma-quasi-compact-existence-universally-closed). The proof (source lines 9705-9772) sets up the valuative diagram over a valuation ring, reduces it using the base change behaviour of dotted arrows and the quasi-compactness hypothesis, applies the existence hypothesis in the reduced form and concludes by the valuative criterion for universal closedness (proof lines 9705-9771). The reduction of the diagram and the transfer of existence between the two forms are the substance. H3.
